current_answer: As of 2 October 2026, reviewed public sources do not establish a broad decline in deployed popular models’ core capability. OpenAI marked ChatGPT Space Pages recovered at 23:44 UTC on 1 October. LiveNerf remained in its Opus 5.5 launch-baseline phase, with 8 of 10 baseline days reported complete and no comparison result. Fresh Reddit sentiment reports show a sharp daily opinion decline, but the site’s rolling seven-day opinion index remained above neutral; neither is task-quality evidence. Check service status before retrying a surface failure, and use the same task and a saved baseline to test capability.

catalogue_card.question: Did Opus 5.5 get worse this week?
catalogue_card.text: No public task test says so yet. Reddit opinion fell in one daily snapshot, but the seven-day index is positive and LiveNerf is still collecting its baseline. OpenAI marked Space Pages recovered.

summary: No reviewed public evidence establishes a broad decline in deployed popular models’ core capability.
OpenAI marked the ChatGPT Space Pages incident resolved at 23:44 UTC on 1 October; this is provider-declared service recovery, not proof for every account.
LiveNerf reported 8/30 daily runs and 8/10 baseline days as of 1 October, with no post-baseline comparison.

A Reddit monitor author reports an early daily Opus 5.5 opinion score of 55 so far on 2 October, down from 71–73 on 25–28 September; the monitor’s separate seven-day index is 67 (95% interval 65–70). Neither measures task performance.
Fresh Reddit posts show both downgrade reports and counterreports without matched task traces. Save a task, route, settings, and artifact; replay after service recovery before switching.
uncertainty: Provider recovery is a status statement, not account-level proof or a completed-answer quality test.
LiveNerf has no post-baseline comparison yet; its narrow panel cannot settle broader user workflows.
The reported daily sentiment snapshot and the seven-day index are different time windows; both measure Reddit opinion, not model output.
No representative user denominator, broad repeated consumer-task time series, first-party pool analytics, or controlled audience pilot is available.
